text.description_html:
Grandeur/Nostalgic Warehouse Parlour Crystal Levers with Spindle

For new installations or restoration replacement parlour crystal levers with 8mm spindle. Comes packaged with 2 levers, 2 allen-head set screws, and an 8mm spindle.

Features of Nostalgic Warehouse Parlour with 8 mm Spindle:

  • Mounting Base Material: Solid Brass
  • Lever Material: Crystal
  • Spindle Length: 3-7/8"
  • Spindle Diameter: Square, 3/8-20 threaded ends
  • Lever Length: 4-3/8"
  • Lever Height: 1-1/4"

Sold as a set: 2 Levers. Special Order Item, NO Returns.
